functions.not_done: A time index, TRA, and grouped data frames are not included. A grouped lag reads the row n places back after that group has been seen n times.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(collapse))
x <- c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, NA)
g <- c("b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a")
m <- matrix(c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3)
d <- data.frame(y = c(1, NA, 3), x = c(4, 5, 6))
gm <- c("b", "a", "b")
grab <- function(obj) {
  vals <- if (is.data.frame(obj)) as.numeric(unlist(obj, use.names = FALSE)) else as.numeric(obj)
  ifelse(is.na(vals), "NA", sprintf("%.17g", vals))
}

one <- function() {
  fdiff(x)
  fdiff(x, n = 2)
  fdiff(c(1, 3, 6, 10), diff = 2)
  fdiff(c(1, 2, 4, 8), log = TRUE)
  fdiff(c(1, 2, 4, 8), rho = 0.5)
}
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import statistics
import time
import numpy as np

functions.not_done: Grouping by several columns, grouped data frames, and zoo are not included. nthreads is accepted and the single-thread result is returned.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(collapse))
fNobs <- function(x, ...) fnobs(x, ...)
x <- c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, NA)
g <- c("b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a")
w <- c(1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1)
m <- matrix(c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3)
d <- data.frame(y = c(1, NA, 3), x = c(4, 5, 6))
gm <- c("b", "a", "b")
grab <- function(obj) {
  vals <- if (is.data.frame(obj)) as.numeric(unlist(obj, use.names = FALSE)) else as.numeric(obj)
  ifelse(is.na(vals), "NA", sprintf("%.17g", vals))
}

one <- function() {
  fmean.default(x, g = g, w = w)
  fmean.default(x, na.rm = FALSE)
  fmean.default(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
}
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import statistics
import time
import numpy as np
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/collapse")
from collapse import *
from collapse.fast import flat
x = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3, 4, 5, np.nan])
g = np.array(["b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a"])
w = np.array([1.0, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1])
m = np.array([[1.0, 4], [np.nan, 5], [3, 6]])
d = {"y": np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3]), "x": np.array([4.0, 5, 6])}
gm = np.array(["b", "a", "b"])

def one():
    fmean_default(x, g=g, w=w)
    fmean_default(x, na_rm=False)
    fmean_default([np.nan, np.nan])

one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("%.17g" % statistics.median(elapsed))
